title: Scaling Multilingual Mixture-of-Experts: How Language Coverage Changes Capacity and Compute Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2610.20247v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multilingual models share capacity across languages, so adding languages can hurt performance on existing ones. Mixture-of-experts models expand this capacity with little additional per-token computation. Given this extra capacity, does adding experts reduce what each additional language costs? To answer this question, we propose a repetition-aware joint scaling law relating number of active parameters, training tokens per language, number of experts, and language coverage. Fitted on 26,300 per-language loss observations from 64 pretrained configurations, our law reduces prediction error on held-out configurations by 28% relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. At matched number of active parameters and training tokens per language, 32 experts reduce the loss penalty of expanding from 12 to 200 languages by 83% compared with a dense model. Our law further shows that broader language coverage favors more experts across a wider range

translated_title: 扩展多语言专家混合模型：语言覆盖范围如何改变容量与计算分配
translated_abstract: 多语言模型在各语言之间共享容量，因此增加语言数量可能会损害现有语言的表现。专家混合模型只需增加极少量的每词元计算即可扩展这一容量。鉴于这种额外容量，增加专家数量能否降低每种新增语言的代价？为回答这一问题，我们提出了一种感知重复的联合缩放定律，将活跃参数数量、每种语言的训练词元数量、专家数量与语言覆盖范围联系起来。该定律基于来自64个预训练配置的26,300个逐语言损失观测数据进行拟合，在留出配置上相比最强评估基线将预测误差降低了28%。在活跃参数数量和每种语言训练词元数量相同的情况下，32个专家相比稠密模型将语言从12种扩展到200种时的损失惩罚降低了83%。我们的定律进一步表明，更广的语言覆盖范围会在更大的参数范围内倾向于使用更多专家。
tldr: 本文提出了一种感知重复的联合缩放定律，揭示多语言MoE模型中活跃参数、训练词元、专家数量与语言覆盖范围之间的关系，并发现32个专家相比稠密模型可将语言从12种扩展到200种时的损失惩罚降低83%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a repetition-aware joint scaling law linking active parameters, training tokens per language, number of experts, and language coverage in multilingual MoE models, showing that 32 experts reduce the loss penalty of expanding from 12 to 200 languages by 83% compared to dense models.
